fields.label: Kind of message
fields.options:
Quotation follow-up
Payment reminder
Enquiry acknowledgement

fields.label: Switched on
fields.description: Off by default. A rule can be switched on only when everything it needs is filled in.

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Manual: each message waits for a person to look at it and press Send. Automatic: it goes out by itself, every check still applies.

fields.label: Send from number
fields.description: Must be switched on for notifications and must not be receive-only.

fields.label: Template
fields.description: An approved Utility template of that number's WhatsApp account. Its values must all be filled from the record (see the template's variable map); a value left on 'Ask each time' stops an automatic send.

fields.label: Days after
fields.description: Quotation follow-up: days after the quotation date. Payment reminder: days after the invoice due date. 0 means not set.

fields.label: Repeat every (days)
fields.description: Days between messages about the same record. Needed when 'Most messages' is more than 1.

fields.label: Ignore records older than (days)
fields.description: A quotation or invoice whose moment came more than this many days ago is left alone, so switching the rule on never messages old records. 0 means no limit.

fields.label: Acknowledge within (minutes)
fields.description: A new enquiry is acknowledged only if it is still this fresh when the message would go. 0 means not set.

fields.label: Most notifications per customer per day
fields.description: Across every rule, so a customer is never flooded.

fields.options: Nothing is sent until: the master switch in Waba Settings is on, this rule is switched on, and the checks pass at the moment of sending (consent, STOP, template still approved, number not receive-only, business hours, limits). Every decision is recorded in the Notification Log with its reason.
